q: 1. Workers aren't allowed to work continuously more than ........
explain: Under the Labor Act, a worker should not work continuously for more than 5 hours without a rest interval.

q: 2. In any project, Public Work Directives (PWD) accept the following guideline
options: present and past regulation of GoN
explain: Public Work Directives are designed to accommodate donor guidelines, government regulations (past and present), and changes in national law, making it a comprehensive guiding document.

q: 3. Who is the Chairperson of Construction Material Rate Fixation Committee?
explain: The Chief District Officer (CDO) chairs the Construction Material Rate Fixation Committee at the district level.

q: 4. According to Public Work Directives (PWD), applicable rate for the liquidity damage is
explain: PWD prescribes liquidated damages for delay at a rate of 0.1% to 0.5% of the contract price per day of delay, subject to a maximum cap.

q: 5. The user's committee method may be used for labour intensive works with a cost estimate of
explain: The user's committee procurement method is applicable for labour-intensive works with an estimated cost up to NRs 2.5 million.

q: 6. Price adjustment in any contract will be done if price change exceeds by ........
explain: As per the answer key, price adjustment applies when the price change exceeds 10%.

q: 7. Direct purchase can be done when the amount is
explain: Direct purchase (procurement without competitive bidding) is permitted under Public Procurement rules when the estimated amount is less than NRs 0.15 million.

q: 8. In Nepal, Public Procurement Act (PPA), was established in
explain: The Public Procurement Act (PPA) of Nepal was enacted in 2063 B.S.

q: 9. The term EPC stands for ........
explain: EPC means Engineering, Procurement and Construction, a turnkey contract where one contractor does all three.

q: 10. For the procurements of works upto 20 million by which method of procurement is ........
options: by direct labor or direct negotiation
explain: As per the answer key, works up to the threshold are procured by sealed quotation.

q: 11. The department head can extend the time up to ........ more than initial contract duration.
explain: As per the answer key, the department head can extend the time up to 25% of the initial duration.

q: 12. The contract adopted if all the items are easily measurable is ........
explain: When all items can be measured easily, an item rate contract is used and payment follows measured quantities.

q: 13. Consulting work worth more than 3 crores should be procured on the basis of ........
explain: As per the answer key, high-value consulting work is procured through international-level EOI followed by RFP.

q: 14. In case of National Competitive Bidding, the prices shall be quoted in
explain: National Competitive Bidding (NCB) rules mandate that financial quotes and transactions must strictly be in Nepalese Rupees (NRs).

q: 15. According to labor act, maximum working hour for a labor per week should be ........
explain: The Labor Act limits regular work to 8 hours a day and 48 hours a week.

q: 16. Who is the chairperson of construction material rate fixation committee?
explain: The Chief District Officer chairs the district rate fixation committee.

q: 17. Time extension may need to be granted due to
options: both a) and b) of above
explain: Contractual time extensions are legally justified by employer/purchaser delays or uncontrollable force majeure events.

q: 18. Who is the Chairperson of Construction Material Rate fixation Committee?
explain: The Chief District Officer (CDO) heads the district-level Rate Fixation Committee for construction materials and labor.

q: 19. "Fraudulent practice" means
options: offering anything to influence the action of public official
buy more than one bid document
mis representation of facts in order to influence a procurement process
explain: Fraudulent practice involves misrepresenting or omitting facts to mislead a party during procurement execution.

q: 20. In LIB type of contract management, the acronym stands for ........
explain: The answer key gives 'limited institutional bidding'. Other sources expand LIB as 'limited international bidding', so verify.

q: 21. Direct purchase for construction work is limited to the amount ........
explain: As per the answer key, the limit is 5 lakh.

q: 22. The PQ criteria are approved by ........
explain: The head of the procuring entity (department head) approves the pre-qualification criteria.

q: 23. The user's committee method of construction is labour intensive with a cost estimate upto (Source:PPR 2064(97)):
explain: As per amended PPR 2064 Rule 97, community labor-based works executed via Users Committees can be awarded up to 10 million NRs (1 Crore).

q: 24. Best option to avoid the undue pressure, cartels and collusion during bidding process is ........
explain: Online e-bidding keeps bidders anonymous and removes physical contact, which reduces pressure and collusion.

q: 25. Which of the following act contains the provision on health and safety of the workers?
explain: The Labor Act contains the provisions on workers' health, safety and welfare.

q: 26. All of the followings are contract types except ........
explain: Unit price, cost reimbursement and lump sum are contract types. 'Make or buy' is a procurement decision, not a contract type.

q: 27. The minimum number of consulting firms for direct purchase of services is ........
explain: As per the answer key, at least 3 consulting firms are needed.

q: 28. For the formation of users committee, members are selected
options: among the people of whole district
among the beneficiaries of the project
by nomination by the chief District officer of the district
explain: User committees must strictly be democratically formed from direct local beneficiaries living in the project impact area.

q: 29. The earnest money deposited by unsuccessful bidder is returned after ........
explain: As per the answer key, bid security of unsuccessful bidders is returned after the contract is awarded.

q: 30. The maximum amount of project cost after the price adjustment should not exceeds ........
explain: As per the answer key, the cost after price adjustment should not exceed 25% of the original cost.

q: 31. EOI is compulsory for procurement of consulting services if work amount exceeds ........
explain: As per the answer key, EOI is compulsory above 20 lakh.

q: 32. The project technical audit is done ........
explain: As per the answer key, the technical audit is carried out after project completion.

q: 33. Security deposits deducted from the contractor's bill is ........
options: refunded when defect liability period is over
refunded upon the completion of work
refunded when good progress is achieved
retained until the life span of project
explain: Retention money guards against defects, so it is released after the defect liability period ends.

q: 34. Which of the following is the logical flow of any project?
explain: The standard project management process groups run in this order: initiation, planning, executing, controlling, closing.
